name: Deedglass
tagline: Rules decide each AI agent tool call; Deedglass checks what really changed.
description: Deedglass sits between your agent and its tools. Policies decide each call, risky ones wait for a person, and every action is checked against the database and sealed as a record you can verify. Self-hosted; no telemetry (Pro checks its licence at most once a day); no key in the install link.
